page.layout: One page with no printed text. Handwritten lines in brown ink in the upper-left area, a second handwritten group below them, and a pencil shelf mark at the lower right.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The brown-ink lines (about seven lines of verse in a 16th–17th century German or Dutch hand) are manuscript annotations, not print, and are left out. The pencil mark "Bd 2061" at the lower right is a shelf mark and is left out. The page is otherwise blank paper with the book's binding edge at the right.
